display_name: gdn decode core bf16 state fp32
description:
Ordinary GDN decode from packed qkvz/ba through causal convolution, recurrent update and in-place gated RMSNorm. Returns None and writes the existing BF16 output, rolling convolution history and FP32 state buffers. Scheduler metadata controls active requests and state indices; inactive output/state regions remain unchanged. D=128 with value/key head ratios 2/3 plus the H4/HV32 ABI geometry; this is a separate ordinary-decode ABI from the MTP checkpoint interface.

Production entry: vllm qwen_gdn_attention_core_fused_norm_packed -> _forward_core_decode_non_spec -> gated norm; fixed source revision source-package-sha256:a58fecb6ecd5d73c569bd3b6d820860c8db26bbde0a1261db505e7952aa6b018.

Parameter domain: shape_range.json defines dynamic request ranges and correlated model/ABI constraints; shape_cases.json fixes 10 representative workloads, not the complete support domain. Pool capacity is independent of active requests; reserve slot 0 and distinct destination/checkpoint slots. Inactive requests and arbitrary slot padding remain supported. Q/K heads=16/TP; value/state heads=16*head_ratio/TP; state per slot is [value_heads,128,128]. No measured traffic weights are claimed. Existing GPU evidence covers only the unchanged fixed sample, not every point in this dynamic domain.

Input construction: State matrices retain [Hv,128,128] and production strides, offsets and shared backing. Normal carried states now come from 32 previous valid tokens with fixed layer A_log/bias and the declared GDN per-head or KDA per-channel decay recurrence, FP32 between stores and actual state dtype at checkpoints. Synthetic raw projections have channel/head gains and AR(1) coefficient .5. Conv history and the current request are contiguous windows of that same process; candidate checkpoint j and convolution accepted-prefix shift refer to the same past endpoint. This is generated history, not captured model data. Existing tiny/zero/saturation/cancellation cases retain their stress construction. Pool capacity and physical slot pattern are independent input parameters, not inferred from request count or candidate width. Slot0/null semantics and unused storage guards remain.

Numerical contract reference-materialization-v1-20261013: Convolution products and accumulation use FP32 on stored inputs; SiLU QKV is materialized in qkvz.dtype (BF16) before normalization/recurrence. Recurrent raw output is materialized in out.dtype (BF16) before gated RMSNorm. State is stored in its declared BF16/FP32 dtype. Native BF16 convolution-product truncation is not part of the reference contract. Independent FP32 between specified storage/QDQ boundaries; TF32 disabled. Unchanged upstream torch.allclose(reference_float, candidate_float, atol=0.01, rtol=0.05). Prior version: evidence/reference-revision-20261013/before.tar.gz. Source and causal evidence: docs/production-bench-v3/CORE_NUMERICAL_ATTRIBUTION_20261013.md.

Current baseline: patched_native; install dependencies/native-fixes/apply.py after the pinned production dependencies. Original native failures are retained; this repair has no new performance baseline.

defined_outputs.outputs_and_state: out active rows, each positive SSM slot exactly once and conv first3 history columns. QKV prefix of positive-slot rows is scratch; Z, null-row QKV, tails, page padding, spare history and all other backing protected. None return; native packed subcall out and state aliases verified.
